detail.title: VR Charger Station for Oculus/Meta Quest 3 & 3S - White
detail.overview: The Ant Esports VR Charger Station is a replacement charging dock built for Oculus/Meta Quest 3 and 3S headsets, combining a display stand for the headset with a mount for both controllers in one tidy unit. It comes with 2 rechargeable batteries so controllers are always ready to swap in without waiting through a full charge cycle, and RGB lighting adds a premium visual touch to any VR setup. The dock keeps the headset and both controllers organized and off the desk or floor between sessions, making it a practical accessory for anyone who plays VR regularly and wants their gear charged and ready to go.
